evidence.observation: T701 reads 358.637 °C while adjacent T702 reads 91.454 °C, an unusually large temperature discontinuity requiring verification.

T701 has risen to 364.352 °C; T702 is 92.697 °C and T712 remains near 70.930 °C. The persistent extreme T701 reading could represent actual overheating or a measurement fault; thermocouple drift is not established.

Pressure and flows remain broadly stable: PY23 698.969 mbar, differential pressures 0.907 and 2.089 mbar, reflux 0.269 L/h and distillate 0.624 L/h; these do not identify the cause of the temperature anomaly.

args.missing_evidence: Independent reboiler temperature measurement, T701 calibration and tag/unit verification, and protocol temperature limits are needed to distinguish overheating from sensor or reporting error. No composition measurement or separation acceptance criterion has been supplied.
